money_cells_2026_08_14_ap_bill_overclaim.note: ap_bill was blanket-required on every financial report leaf regardless of whether the report actually surfaces bill/vendor line-item data. Verified live per-leaf (grep against each page component, not assumed): trial_balance/profit_loss/balance_sheet/cash_flow* are GL-account rollups only (rows keyed by account_id, drill to the CoA register — zero vendor_id/bill_id anywhere); settlement_summary/customer_profitability/maintenance_cost_per_unit/runner.cash_position carry zero vendor or bill references at all. None of these ever owed ap_bill. report.ar_aging and report.ap_aging (real vendor+bill drill, verify-aging-report-reverse-leaves.mjs) and report.management (vendor-level AP aging summary table, EntityLink kind=vendor, verify-report-management-ap-aging.mjs) keep it — they are the only reports leaves that genuinely surface AP-bill-adjacent data. report.ar_aging also never owed ap_bill — it's a receivables report (customer/invoice), zero bill_id anywhere in ARAgingPage.tsx; corrected in the same pass.

customer_column_2026_08_14_overclaim.note: 38 of 42 reports leaves carried no customer data: GL-rollup reports (trial_balance/profit_loss/balance_sheet/cash_flow*/settlement_summary) and unit/driver/fuel/geofence-scoped reports render zero customer_id. Only report.management (embedded AR-aging section), report.ar_aging, report.customer_profitability, and report.dispatch_margin genuinely render EntityLink kind="customer".

vendor_column_2026_08_14_overclaim.note: 12 of 14 reports leaves carried no vendor data: report.ar_aging is correctly customer-scoped only; GL-rollup reports (trial_balance/profit_loss/balance_sheet/cash_flow*/settlement_summary) and customer/unit-scoped reports (customer_profitability/fuel_reconciliation/maintenance_cost_per_unit) render zero vendor_id; runner.cash_position has no backing runner config at all (falls back to an unavailable-report stub). Only report.management (embedded open-vendor-balances table) and report.ap_aging genuinely render EntityLink kind="vendor".

unit_column_2026_08_14_overclaim.note: 22 of 29 reports leaves are false: IFTA (aggregate fleet-level filing, not per-unit), cancellations, lane/trip profitability, late-arrival, dispatch-margin, and booking-gap have zero unit_id; most runner.* leaves have no backing RUNNER_CONFIGS entry at all (unavailable-config stub) or a config scoped to driver-financial data only; runner.maint_cost_unit has a real unit_number column but RunnerTable.tsx never renders EntityLink for ANY column — the number is inert text, not a real link, unlike the standalone report.maintenance_cost_per_unit page. The other 7 leaves KEEP the Required marking — real EntityLink kind="unit" confirmed in PerTruckCpmReport.tsx, ProfitPerTruckPage.tsx, FuelReconciliationPage.tsx, MaintenanceCostPerUnitPage.tsx, GeofenceDwellReport.tsx, GeofenceReconciliationReport.tsx, and DeadheadReportPage.tsx.
